rules.text: List the property on the NSW short-term rental accommodation (STRA) register before advertising, and show its registration number on listings.
rules.fee_note: Secondary sources say about A$65 first registration and A$25 yearly renewal.

rules.text: Non-hosted stays are capped at 180 nights in each 12-month period. Bookings of 21 or more nights in a row do not count.
Most of Byron Shire has a 60-night cap for non-hosted stays (since September 2024), except mapped precincts.
Some regional councils, including parts of Ballina, also apply a 180-night cap. Full list to be confirmed.
The STRA fire safety standard applies (for example smoke alarms and an evacuation diagram). Exact items to be confirmed.
An owners corporation can pass a by-law banning short stays in lots that are not the host's principal place of residence. It cannot ban short stays where the host lives there.
